name: Aaron Bollinger
quote: Hoang is a reliable, high-output contributor who consistently turns complex work into tangible results. His technical work has driven real value for the team, and his attention to detail has helped bring new internal tools online smoothly. He's also shown strong agility managing competing priorities, delivering complex data integration work in short timeframes without sacrificing quality.

name: Heysam Salami
quote: One of the many positive traits that Le has, is his ability to take what we have as a vision for a project and turn it into reality. He created a few dashboards that were able to allow us to better understand where our business stands with not only target dates, but also easily view planned to actual data side by side. He did this, while creating convenient and creative ways to input data easily.

name: Barry Fleming
